lifetime_review: The sole PTY owner retains the leader through observations, bounded stop and group retirement; its close is idempotent. The absent-group setup path accepts only reserved waitid-confirmed exit within the original deadline. The stop-marker string view borrows an owned noslices buffer only during a synchronous read-only call and expires before any append; complete-log verdicts use a copy. The work-tree defer follows every staging/compiler/archive/guest failure; no shared input link is removed by cleanup.
limits: Controlled fixture builders and VM only; no new iOS/graphics/kernel result. USTAR content/mode/link semantics retained but order/padding and gzip filename/timestamp headers can differ. Alternate runner root supplies the boot script rather than Python callbacks. Concurrently staged object bridge and legacy Python files remain intact; zero retirement credit.
